helpers.statement: ∀ τ α β : ℝ, 0 < τ → β ≠ 0 → ‖KdVPlan.eta τ α β‖ ≤ 2 * |α/β|
helpers.proof:
intro τ α β hτ hβ
let A : ℂ := (KdVPlan.phase α τ - KdVPlan.avg τ (KdVPlan.phase α)) * KdVPlan.phase β τ
let B : ℂ := (KdVPlan.phase α 0 - KdVPlan.avg τ (KdVPlan.phase α)) * KdVPlan.phase β 0
let I : ℂ := ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..τ, ((-Complex.I * (α : ℂ)) * KdVPlan.phase α t) * KdVPlan.phase β t
have hi : ‖I‖ ≤ |α| * τ := by
  have hi := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := τ)
    (f := fun t => ((-Complex.I * (α : ℂ)) * KdVPlan.phase α t) * KdVPlan.phase β t)
    (C := |α|) (fun t _ => by simp [norm_mul, yui_aux_0001 T gamma R, Complex.norm_real])
  simpa [I, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hτ] using hi
have heq : (-Complex.I * (β : ℂ)) * (τ : ℂ) * KdVPlan.eta τ α β = A - B - I :=
  yui_aux_0011 T gamma R τ α β (ne_of_gt hτ)
have hb : ‖(-Complex.I * (β : ℂ)) * (τ : ℂ) * KdVPlan.eta τ α β‖ ≤ ‖A‖ + ‖B‖ + ‖I‖ := by
  rw [heq]
  exact yui_aux_0013 T gamma R A B I
simp only [norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_I, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, one_mul, abs_of_pos hτ] at hb
have he : ‖A‖ + ‖B‖ ≤ τ * |α| := by
  simpa [A, B, norm_mul, yui_aux_0001 T gamma R, add_comm] using (yui_aux_0008 T gamma R τ α hτ).2
have hm : |β| * ‖KdVPlan.eta τ α β‖ ≤ 2 * |α| := by
  apply yui_aux_0012 T gamma R τ _ _ hτ
  nlinarith
rw [abs_div, ← mul_div_assoc]
apply (le_div_iff₀ (abs_pos.mpr hβ)).mpr
nlinarith [hm]

unfold KdVPlan.CovarianceBounds
intro τ α β hτ
constructor
· intro hz
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hz with hα | hβ
  · subst α
    exact yui_aux_0016 T gamma R τ β hτ
  · subst β
    rw [yui_aux_0015 T gamma R]
    exact yui_aux_0016 T gamma R τ α hτ
· intro hn
  have hα : α ≠ 0 := fun h => hn (by simp [h])
  have hβ : β ≠ 0 := fun h => hn (by simp [h])
  have hrα := yui_aux_0014 T gamma R τ α β hτ hβ
  have hrβ : ‖KdVPlan.eta τ α β‖ ≤ 2 * |β / α| := by
    rw [yui_aux_0015 T gamma R]
    exact yui_aux_0014 T gamma R τ β α hτ hα
  have hsα := yui_aux_0010 T gamma R τ α β hτ
  have hsβ : ‖KdVPlan.eta τ α β‖ ≤ τ * |β| := by
    rw [yui_aux_0015 T gamma R]
    exact yui_aux_0010 T gamma R τ β α hτ
  constructor
  · rcases le_total |α / β| |β / α| with h | h
    · rw [min_eq_left h]
      exact hrα
    · rw [min_eq_right h]
      exact hrβ
  · rcases le_total |α| |β| with h | h
    · rw [min_eq_left h]
      exact hsα
    · rw [min_eq_right h]
      exact hsβ
